title: Align on the Fly: Adapting Chatbot Behavior to Established Norms
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark was designed to measure the alignment of Large Language Models with established legal and moral norms, with a specific focus on Chinese law and secular morality derived from textbooks, professional guidelines, and the NormBank dataset of social norms.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it did not evaluate models on religious knowledge, bias, or alignment with religious norms. The entire study is focused on secular legal and moral frameworks.
